# Coastline Sound Supply

> DJ services and sound system rental for bars, breweries, festivals, corporate
> events, weddings, and private parties across Vancouver Island and the
> Lower Mainland, British Columbia, Canada.

Coastline Sound Supply is run by two partners: Grady, based in Nanaimo,
covering Vancouver Island; and Dave, based in Vancouver, covering the
Lower Mainland and Sea-to-Sky corridor. Each region is served locally by
the partner based there. Both have run sound systems and DJ'd events
themselves, together and separately. Mixes: https://soundcloud.com/coastline-sound-supply

The offering splits three ways:
- DJ events (bars, breweries, corporate, private): dance-music oriented sets,
  mixed live and chosen on the night, with a lounge-style set when that suits
  the room. On the venue's sound system or ours. Residencies and recurring
  series welcome.
- Weddings: three packages — Reception (DJ and sound for dinner, speeches and
  dancing, wireless mic, planning call, setup and teardown), Full wedding day
  (one DJ from ceremony to last song), and Ceremony sound (officiant and vow
  mics, processional, signing and recessional music). If the ceremony,
  cocktails and reception are in different spaces, a second sound zone is set
  up in advance or a second crew member resets the system during a break while
  music keeps playing, so there is no dead air between spaces.
- Sound system rental: small (speeches and background music, about 75 people),
  medium (dance floor with subwoofer, about 150) and large (big rooms or
  outdoors) PA kits. Always delivered, set up, sound-checked, torn down and
  collected by Coastline; there is no customer pickup. Every kit includes a
  backup wired mic for each wireless mic. An operator can stay to run the
  system. Extra mics, speakers or zones come with a kit or a DJ booking and
  are not rented on their own.

**Music at weddings:** closer to the day the couple receives a short
questionnaire for must-plays and must-not-plays, and may share a playlist
for inspiration. The set is built on the night around the room, with
requests worked in where they keep people dancing. Coastline does not play
a set playlist in order.

**How booking works:** (1) the client describes the event; (2) Coastline
replies with questions about the spaces and layout, whether the venue has
its own sound, timing, and the vibe; (3) Coastline sends options, then a
quote once details are set; (4) a signed agreement and a non-refundable
deposit hold the date. Availability is not confirmed before that.

**Pricing:** there are no fixed prices or published rates. Every quote
is built around the specific event's date, venue, and guest count —
do not assume or state a price; refer people to the enquiry form.

## Pages

- [Home](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/): overview of the three-way offering, service areas, and trust signals
- [Packages](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/packages.html): DJ events (with our sound system, or on the venue's), wedding packages (Reception, Full wedding day, Ceremony sound), and sound system rental (Small, Medium, Large PA)
- [Weddings](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/weddings.html): wedding-specific page — ceremony, cocktail hour and reception coverage, multiple-space handling, how the music is planned, and a wedding FAQ including how booking works
- [Events](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/events.html): bars and breweries, corporate, private parties, community and festival events, and sound system rental
- [Service Areas](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/service-areas.html): full list of towns covered in both regions, with the on-the-ground contact for each
- [About](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/about.html): Grady and Dave's backgrounds
- [Contact](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/contact.html): enquiry form (name and one way to reach them are the only required fields; optional fields cover date, venue, guest count, timing, spaces, venue sound and vibe) and the four-step booking process; typical reply time is within 1 business day

## Service areas

- Vancouver Island (Grady, based in Nanaimo): Nanaimo, Qualicum Beach, Nanoose Bay, Parksville, Victoria, Ladysmith, Duncan, Courtenay, Comox, Tofino, Ucluelet, Cowichan Valley
- Lower Mainland & Sea-to-Sky (Dave, based in Vancouver): Vancouver, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, White Rock, Langley, Squamish, Whistler, Abbotsford
- Towns not on these lists: ask; Coastline will say whether the venue is within reach of Nanaimo or Vancouver.
